issue.title: bob plugins sync/list should warn when a deployed custom plugin's vault folder is not git-ignored or is tracked

task_type_fields.proposal:
`bob plugins sync` and `bob plugins list` should check, for every custom plugin they deploy, that the vault ignores `.obsidian/plugins/<id>/` and tracks none of its files, and warn loudly (sync output, JSON, and the list/drift view) when it does not. Today nothing ties the plugin roster to `~/bob/.gitignore`: its custom-plugin block lists each plugin folder by hand, so a newly added plugin is committed by vault-sync and one host's deploy overwrites another's (this is exactly bob-cli-cd, where bob-articles was missed for ~10 days).

Evidence: `src/native/plugins/{sync,scan,guard}.rs` never consult the vault's ignore rules (no `gitignore`/`check-ignore` use in `src/native/plugins/`). The fix for bob-cli-cd (vault commit 0b682436, gate custom-cda73055-0c77-470b-812c-254b91448337) hand-added `.gitignore:69` and untracked the files on athena, apollo, and mac in one coordinated step; bob-command-mode was likewise hand-added at `.gitignore:70`.

Proposed scope: detection plus warning, implemented with `git check-ignore` / `git ls-files` against the vault. Never run `git rm --cached` automatically, because untracking on one host deletes the files on the others at their next pull. Whether sync may also append a missing ignore line itself, when no plugin file is tracked yet, is a design choice for the triager. It writes the shared vault `.gitignore` through vault-sync.

Proposed by phase bob-cli-an.6.6.6.5.6.5.5.6.6.6.6.6.1 (PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP, note #2) and routed by the batch-13 lander.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Batch-13 phase vault-plugin-ignore owned only the bob-cli-cd repair: add the bob-articles ignore rule and run a coordinated untrack plus redeploy across hosts. Making the plugin roster enforce the vault ignore rules is new bob plugins tooling, outside that bounded repair and outside the batch's five-task assignment.

issue.creation_reason: Batch-13 phase .1 proposed it after fixing bob-cli-cd: the vault .gitignore custom-plugin block is hand-maintained, so the next new plugin can be silently tracked and overwritten across hosts again.

payload.description: The incident this feature prevents recurring: bob-articles was hand-omitted from the vault custom-plugin ignore block
